<script>
(() => {
  if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.style.opacity = 1;
        e.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        io.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    }
  }, { threshold: 0.12 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.home-card, .now-block').forEach((el, i) => {
    el.style.opacity = 0;
    el.style.transform = 'translateY(8px)';
    el.style.transition = `opacity 480ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.1,1) ${i * 30}ms, transform 480ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.1,1) ${i * 30}ms`;
    io.observe(el);
  });
})();
</script>
